title: Mobile test — dealer locator at 390×844
featureSummary: Verify the dealer locator page (search input, Locate me button, top-cities scroller, results page) renders and functions correctly at mobile viewport 390×844.
conclusion: 2 MAJOR bugs found on mobile (390×844): the 'Locate me' button is not visible/tappable until the search input is focused (AC-1), and dealer card addresses are CSS-truncated on the results page (AC-3). Top-cities scroller (AC-2) and the mobile nav → Find Dealers path (comment scenario) both pass cleanly.

acceptanceCriteria.requirement: The dealer search input and "Locate me" button are both fully visible and tappable at 390px width, with no horizontal overflow on the page
The top cities horizontal scroller is swipeable on mobile, and every city can be scrolled into view and tapped — the fade gradient must not visually cover or block taps on the last visible city
Selecting a city from mobile reaches the results page, and dealer cards stack in a single readable column with no text truncation or overlapping elements

commentScenarios.summary: Does the header navigation collapse into a hamburger/mobile menu, and if so, is "Find Dealers" still reachable from it in fewer than 3 taps?
commentScenarios.notes: Tapping the hamburger icon (top-left) opens the mobile nav overlay, which shows a "Find Dealers" CTA directly at the bottom — reachable in 1 tap, well under the 3-tap bar.

scenarios.name: Dealer locator page loads with its core elements at 390×844
scenarios.expected: Heading, productline selector, search input and top-cities list render without error.
scenarios.actual: Page loaded correctly; heading "Dealer Locator For Car Tires", search input and city chips (Atlanta/Chicago/Dallas/Los Angeles partially visible) all rendered as expected.

scenarios.name: Search input is visible and tappable on load
steps: Inspect the "Enter a city, suburb, town or zip code" input
scenarios.expected: Input box fully visible, full width within the 390px viewport, tappable.
scenarios.actual: Input renders full-width with visible search icon; no clipping.

scenarios.name: "Locate me" button is visible and tappable on load
steps: Load the dealer locator page (no interaction)
scenarios.expected: "Locate me" button fully visible and tappable at 390px width immediately on load, per AC-1.
scenarios.actual: Button has opacity:0 and a bounding box partly off-canvas (x:-2) on initial load — hidden and not natively clickable. It only becomes visible (opacity:1) after the user taps into the search input first. See BUG-1.

scenarios.name: No horizontal page overflow at 390px width
scenarios.actual: scrollWidth === innerWidth === 390. No horizontal overflow found anywhere on the page.

scenarios.name: Top-cities scroller is swipeable and all 5 cities can be reached
steps: Simulate a touch swipe / wheel scroll to the right
scenarios.expected: The list scrolls horizontally, and Atlanta, Chicago, Dallas, Los Angeles and New York all become reachable.
scenarios.actual: List scrolled from 0 to 189.5px (its max scrollLeft, 548-358=190), confirming all 5 cities are reachable by a native swipe/scroll gesture.

scenarios.name: Fade gradient does not block taps on the last visible city
steps: Scroll the top-cities list to its max scroll position (New York fully visible)
Hit-test the point under the right-edge gradient, over the New York link
scenarios.expected: A tap anywhere on the New York chip, including under the gradient overlay, must reach the link — not be intercepted by the gradient.
scenarios.actual: The gradient overlay has pointer-events:none; elementFromPoint at the overlapping region resolves to the <a class="ds__btn"> New York link itself. Taps pass through cleanly. Visually, "New-York" is fully legible in the screenshot (note: label reads "New-York" with a hyphen — see Observations).

scenarios.name: Selecting Atlanta reaches the results page with single-column cards
scenarios.expected: Navigates to /auto/dealer-locator/atlanta; dealer cards stack in one readable column matching the 390px viewport.
scenarios.actual: Navigated to the Atlanta results page (563 dealers); cards (Midas, Gordy Tire and Automotive, ...) stack cleanly in a single column at full card width.

scenarios.name: Dealer card addresses are not truncated
steps: On the Atlanta results page, inspect the address line of each visible card
Compare scrollWidth vs clientWidth of the address element
scenarios.expected: Full street address is readable with no ellipsis/clipping, per AC-3.
scenarios.actual: Address `<span>` elements are styled with white-space:nowrap; text-overflow:ellipsis at a fixed 300px width — e.g. "1590 HOWELL MILL RD NW, Georgia, ATLANT…" is cut off. Reproduced on 2 of 2 addresses checked and confirmed again in a fresh browser context. See BUG-2.

scenarios.name: No overlapping elements between cards
steps: On the Atlanta results page, check the bounding boxes of the "See map" quick-link and the "Contact dealer" CTA on the Gordy Tire card
scenarios.expected: No two interactive elements should visually overlap, per AC-3.
scenarios.actual: Overlap between the "See map" pill and the "Contact dealer" CTA reproduced on 2 of 4 checks across fresh contexts (screenshot attached) — timing-dependent on when the star-rating badge finishes rendering and shifts card height. Not consistently reproducible enough to meet the Fail Recheck Gate for a confirmed bug; recorded as an observation, not BUG-3.

scenarios.name: Find Dealers is reachable from the mobile nav in under 3 taps
scenarios.expected: "Find Dealers" reachable in fewer than 3 taps from the collapsed mobile nav.
scenarios.actual: 1 tap: the hamburger opens directly to an overlay with a "Find Dealers" link/button visible near the bottom, alongside "Tire Selector".

scenarios.name: Back button restores the search page after selecting a city
steps: Navigate to the Atlanta results page
scenarios.actual: Back button returned to https://www.michelinman.com/auto/dealer-locator with the empty search input restored — no stuck state.

scenarios.name: Atlanta results state persists on a fresh URL load
steps: Open /auto/dealer-locator/atlanta directly in a brand-new tab (simulating a copied URL)
scenarios.expected: Results render directly without needing to re-search.
scenarios.actual: Fresh tab loaded straight into the Atlanta results page title and dealer cards (Midas, Gordy Tire) with no extra interaction needed.

scenarios.name: Product-line switch (Auto → Motorcycle) on the dealer locator
scenarios.expected: Switches the active product line without breaking the layout.
scenarios.actual: Dropdown opened, "Motorcycle" selected, control label updated to " Motorcycle " with no layout break.

scenarios.name: Map zoom control responds
scenarios.expected: Map zoom control is present and clickable.
scenarios.actual: Zoom-in control found and clicked successfully with no error.

scenarios.name: Footer link group renders with working hrefs
scenarios.expected: Footer link block renders with a valid href.
scenarios.actual: First footer link ("Automotive Tires" → /auto) present with a valid relative href.

scenarios.name: Breadcrumb "Home" link is present
scenarios.expected: Breadcrumb shows Home / Auto / Find a dealer.
scenarios.actual: Breadcrumb present with a working "Home" link.

scenarios.name: TC-AN1 — analytics events fire during dealer-locator interaction
scenarios.expected: At least one dataLayer push or analytics request fires after an interaction.
scenarios.actual: window.dataLayer grew from 12 to 18 entries across the session's interactions — analytics instrumentation is firing.

bugs.title: "Locate me" button is invisible and not tappable on initial page load (390×844)
steps: Inspect .dl__autocomplete-locate — computed opacity is 0, tabindex is -1, bounding box x:-2 (partly off-canvas)
elementFromPoint at the button's own coordinates resolves to the parent .dl__dealer-search__container, not the button — a native Playwright click times out waiting for actionability
Tap/focus the search input — opacity becomes 1 and the button becomes visible (tabindex stays -1)
bugs.expected: Per AC-1, the "Locate me" button is fully visible and tappable at 390px width without any prior interaction.
bugs.actual: The button is invisible (opacity:0) and not hit-testable at the point a user would tap on initial load. It only appears once the search input is focused — a workaround exists, but AC-1 is not met as written for the page's initial state.
bugs.impact: A mobile user landing on the page cannot see or use "Locate me" until they first tap into the search field, which is not an obvious affordance and directly contradicts AC-1.

bugs.title: Dealer card street addresses are CSS-truncated with an ellipsis on mobile results cards
steps: Inspect the address <span> under each dealer card — white-space:nowrap, text-overflow:ellipsis, fixed width:300px
scrollWidth (343–361px) exceeds clientWidth (300px) for every address checked
Reproduced identically in a second, fresh browser context on the same URL
bugs.expected: Per AC-3, dealer card addresses must render with no text truncation on mobile.
bugs.actual: Addresses are visibly cut off with an ellipsis, e.g. "1590 HOWELL MILL RD NW, Georgia, ATLANT…" — the full address is not readable in the card without opening the external map link.
bugs.impact: Users cannot read the full dealer address directly on the results card at 390px width, contradicting AC-3's explicit no-truncation requirement.

consoleErrors: 24 console errors captured, all of the same two recurring types (not caused by test actions):
Repeated CSP violations: "Loading media from 'data:audio/mpeg;base64,...' violates ... default-src *" — a third-party chat-widget ("Mitch") notification sound blocked by CSP.
Repeated "Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 400/404" tied to the network failures listed below.
networkFailures: 400 https://dctityd.michelinman.com/status-log (repeated, first-party — a status/analytics logging endpoint; no visible UI impact observed)

viewportSummary.issuesFound: N/A — ticket scoped exclusively to mobile (390×844)
2 MAJOR bugs (BUG-1, BUG-2), 1 intermittent layout observation

observations: "New-York" top-city label uses a hyphen ("New-York") instead of "New York" — likely a raw-slug label leaking into the UI; MINOR copy issue, not covered by any AC.

The "Locate me" button keeps tabindex="-1" even after it becomes visible (post search-input focus), so it remains unreachable via keyboard/switch-control navigation — an accessibility gap beyond AC-1's literal wording, worth a follow-up ticket.

Intermittent overlap between the "See map" quick-link and a card's "Contact dealer" CTA (Gordy Tire card, Atlanta results) reproduced in 2 of 4 checks — appears tied to the timing of the star-rating badge render shifting card height. Flagged for developer review even though it did not meet the two-for-two Fail Recheck Gate for a confirmed bug.

404s for BMW/Audi/Genesis partner network logos from a third-party CDN (cdn-prod-nam.yepgarage.info) were observed in the network log; not confirmed as visually broken within this run's scope (Filters panel was not opened) — recommend a follow-up check.
CDL-xxx known-defect references: none found in the ticket or comments for this area.

automationGap.recommendation: "Mobile and tablet viewports" is already a declared knownGap for this suite. This run confirms it is where two real MAJOR bugs live (the Locate me button and address truncation) — closing S1, S3, S7, S11 and S12 as automated mobile-viewport scenarios (all buildable from existing step vocabulary) would give regression coverage for the two bugs found here at minimal cost.
